text: Visitors have noted issues with signage and accessibility, particularly regarding the lack of clear directions to handicap parking and limited shuttle service from the parking area to the library entrance. Several reviews mentioned frustration with the timed-entry ticket system, including surprise at the requirement to purchase tickets in advance and delays in entry. The use of AI in exhibits received mixed feedback, with some finding it poorly executed or distorted, and concerns were raised about the high proportion of replica items on display. Food options in the café were described as limited and disappointing by some visitors. Despite these concerns, the architecture and interactive exhibits were frequently mentioned positively.

There were also occasional comments about crowding, queues, and limited restroom availability. Overall, the average rating remains high, but attention to accessibility and exhibit presentation could improve the visitor experience.
